text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of her Debut race, Fine Motion 
seemed giddy with excitement ahead of the 
race. However, she had an idea in mind...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It meant that... in order to run with all 
her might, she needed to enjoy it with all 
her heart. From here on, her true race 
begins—!
